item.title: Kristi Noem Put Her Foot In Her Mouth And Says The SAVE Act Quiet Part Out Loud
item.description: Republicans are trying to sell the SAVE Act as "election integrity" by DHS Secretary Kristi Noem, who has nothing to do with elections, blew that up by saying the quiet part out loud.

item.title: Thomas Massie Destroys Trump By Calling Him The Epstein Administration
item.description: Rep. Thomas Massie (R-KY) said that Donald Trump is protecting the Epstein class, and that his presidency is the Epstein administration.

item.title: Democrats Say They'll Spend Whatever It Takes To Stop Trump's Election Rigging Plot
item.description: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries (D-NY) said that Democrats are committed to spending as much money as it takes to prevent Republicans from misleading voters about Trump's election rigging plot.

item.title: Here Is Why Donald Trump Is The Biggest Failure In Presidential History
item.description: Donald Trump is the biggest failure in presidential history because he designed a fatally flawed administration intended to serve only himself.

item.title: The Banning Of James Talarico's Stephen Colbert Interview Has Backfired On Republicans
item.description: Republicans are so afraid of Democratic Texas US Senate candidate James Talarico that CBS banned his interview from airing on Stephen Colbert, and the gambit backfired.

item.title: A Key Group Just Abandoned Trump, And It Spells Disaster For Republicans
item.description: A new Reuters poll shows that Trump's approval rating is 38%, but the backbone of Trump's support on immigration is cracking, and it is a signal that disaster is coming for Republicans.

item.title: Trump May Have Lost The Senate By Trying To Censor James Talarico
item.description: Trump and his administration attempted to deny state Rep. James Talarico a platform on CBS, but instead, they turned him into a massive star.

item.title: Mentally Gone Trump Shows Up At Black History Month Event To Rant About Joe Biden
item.description: Trump showed up at the White House's Black History Month event to spew election conspiracies, rant about Joe Biden, and list his black friends.

item.title: Trump Hints At Prosecuting Obama For Leaking Classified Information
item.description: Trump said Obama made a big mistake and leaked classified information when the former president suggested that he believes aliens are real, but Obama, unlike Trump, didn't leak anything.

item.title: A Sweaty And Babbling Trump Tried To Deliver An Economic Speech In Georgia And It Was A Disaster
item.description: Trump went to Rome, GA to deliver a supposed speech on the economy, but what happened was a sweaty and rambling president buried himself and the Republican Party under his babble.
